name: THYMOLUM
key_symptoms: Tired, aching throughout lumbar region. Worse, mental and physical labor.
guiding_symptoms: Tired, aching throughout lumbar region. Worse, mental and physical labor.
urinary_symptoms: Profuse, nightly, seminal emissions with lascivious dreams of a perverted character. Priapism. Urinary burning and subsequent dribbling of urine. Polyuria. Urates increased. Phosphates decreased.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Tired, aching throughout lumbar region. Worse, mental and physical labor.
sleep_symptoms: Awakes tired and unrefreshed. Lascivious and fantastic dreams.

source.title: THYMOLUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
